m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: Well, howdy there, stranger, what can old Granny do for you today?
A Big Bad Wolf? In my little homestead? Nah, I don't think that's the case. 'Fraid your information's a bit off.
Oh, well, I reckon you can check inside if you insist. But all you'll find is some fresh-baked biscuits.
Well, come on then, I'll let you in.
Well, did you give that Big Bad Wolf what for?
Grandma was the wolf? AND a Myth Monster? Figures. Nice people always have a monster lurking within...
Which, I guess in this case, is nicer than the nice person, who is actually horrible. So maybe monsters aren't all bad, but people are?
Nah, that don't seem right. I don't know what the moral of this story is, Wizard, but thanks for helping out.
Hey there, Wizard, I could use a hand with something, iff'n you don't mind. We got ourselves a little wolf problem.
A Big Bad Wolf to be specific. So far it's stolen Bo Peep's sheep, attacked three little pigs, ate a little red riding hood I made as a gift for my daughter...
...Snuck up on a boy who kept crying its name, been caught running around in sheep's clothing and now I hear it's taken over Grandmother's House!
Now, Grandma ain't nobody's literal grandma, just a little old lady what showed up a while back, but she's good folk, bakes us cookies.
So, in the name of all things good and dessert, I hereby deputize you to save Grandma from the Big Bad Wolf. And hurry!
Get going, Wizard. Grandma ain't gonna save herself. Well, maybe she will. But it's best to be sure.
